question: If the ratio of two numbers is 2 : 5, and their HCF is 29, then their LCM is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM = HCF × Product of co-prime ratios

LCM = 29 × (2 × 5)

LCM = 29 × 10 = 290

**∴ The correct answer is 290.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Ratio = 2 : 5, HCF = 29

Formula: LCM = HCF × a × b (where a, b are co-prime ratios)

 Number 1 (2 × HCF) Number 2 (5 × HCF) 
• LCM = 29 × 2 × 5 = 290 

⇒ Let the numbers be 2x and 5x, where x is the HCF.

⇒ x = 29

⇒ First Number = 2 × 29 = 58

⇒ Second Number = 5 × 29 = 145

⇒ LCM = 29 × 2 × 5

⇒ LCM = 290

**∴ The correct answer is 290.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Relation

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM. This applies only to two numbers.

Ratio and HCF

If two numbers are in the ratio a : b and their HCF is H, then the numbers are Ha and Hb. Their LCM is H × a × b.

Co-prime Numbers

Numbers whose HCF is 1 are called co-prime numbers. The LCM of co-prime numbers is equal to their product.
